	precondition:
		Librarian.allInstance()->excludes(librarianid)
	postcondition:
		let librarian: Librarian in
		librarian.oclIsNew() and
		librarian.LibrarianID = librarianid and
		librarian.Name = name and
		librarian.Password = password and
		Librarian.allInstance()->includes(librarian) and
		result = true
